title: Find Xor-Beauty of Array
summary: Given an array of integers, calculate the XOR of the effective values for all possible triplets (i, j, k) where the effective value is defined as ((nums[i] | nums[j]) & nums[k]).
statement: Given an array of integers, calculate the XOR of the effective values for all possible triplets (i, j, k) where the effective value is defined as ((nums[i] | nums[j]) & nums[k]). Return the result, noting that | is bitwise OR and & is bitwise AND.
constraints: For every ordered index triplet (i,j,k), compute (nums[i] OR nums[j]) AND nums[k].
XOR all n cubed triplet values together.
reference_solution:
def xor_beauty(nums):
    answer=0
    for value in nums:answer^=value
    return answer
known_wrong_solutions:
def xor_beauty(nums):
    answer=0
    for value in nums:answer|=value
    return answer
def xor_beauty(nums):
    answer=0
    for value in nums:answer&=value
    return answer
hints: Analyze each bit independently and use parity because the final operation is XOR.
Expanding OR into XOR and AND terms makes all cross-index contributions appear an even number of times.
Only each original value's surviving diagonal contribution remains.
Therefore the cubic expression equals the XOR of all input values, which can be accumulated in one scan.

tests.explanation: The XOR across all eight ordered triplets simplifies to 1 XOR 4 = 5.
Bitwise cancellation leaves the same value as XORing the array, which is 34.
